description: This file defines the OAuth2Clients class, which extends SugarBean and manages OAuth2 client configurations within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes properties related to OAuth2 client data such as secret, redirect URI, grant types, and duration settings, along with methods for saving and summarizing the client data.

classes.name: OAuth2Clients
classes.description: A class representing OAuth2 client configurations, including properties and methods for managing OAuth2 client data within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the OAuth2 client, specifically the 'name' property.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the OAuth2 client, hashing a new secret if provided and setting duration values based on request parameters.

methods.name: setDurationValue
methods.description: Calculates and sets the duration in seconds based on 'duration_amount' and 'duration_unit' request parameters.
